headline: Conagra Brands Canada Introduces Marigold, Bringing Chef-Inspired Indian Flavours to Canadian Homes
summary: TORONTO, Aug. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Canadians can now experience the bold, vibrant tastes of Indian cuisine at home with the launch of Marigold™, a new brand from Conagra Brands Canada offering chef-inspired frozen entrées and cooking sauces.
